refinedPrompt: Build a SystemDiagnostics component deep inside the project to test directory auto-creation, package installation, and automated lint enforcement.
projectSummary: This is a medium-sized test plan designed to rigorously stress-test the Void Agent's God-Mode features, including deep path routing, terminal execution, lint-loop repair, and chat history persistence.

tasks.title: Install required dependencies
tasks.description: Run a terminal command to install `clsx` and `tailwind-merge` which we will use for our diagnostics component. After installing, briefly verify they exist in package.json using <read_file>. Remember to use <think> tags before you execute any tools.

tasks.title: Create SystemDiagnostics component with an intentional error
tasks.description:
Use <rewrite_file> to create a new file at `src/vs/workbench/contrib/void/browser/react/src/testing-area/deep-folder/SystemDiagnostics.tsx` (this tests auto-directory creation). 

Inside this file, write a simple React component that renders a stylized card (using tailwind) indicating 'System Online'.

CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: You MUST intentionally introduce a minor TypeScript error in this file (e.g., using a variable that hasn't been declared, or forgetting to import React). This is required to test the pipeline's native lint-enforcement loop. It should throw a lint error after you write it, causing you to automatically replan and fix it.

tasks.title: Fix the lint error and finalize
tasks.description: If the previous task successfully triggered a lint error, use <edit_file> to repair the TypeScript error you introduced. Once it compiles cleanly without lint errors, the test is complete. If it didn't trigger an error, just add a console.log statement.
